decided: LST-0 (#7482), measured while seeding the ledger
decision: The Elench empty-state suggestion carousel cycles 3-card pages over a fixed set of prompt suggestions. It is not a list read: nothing is fetched, so there is no server page to read instead.
bound: The set is a compile-time constant (`ORG_SUGGESTIONS` / `PROJECT_SUGGESTIONS` in components/agent/elench/elench-suggestions.tsx, nine entries each); it can only grow in a reviewed diff.
